$comment: DRAFT ledger for issue #60: Hayao Miyazaki only. Same schema as essential10-example.json (schemaVersion 1); extra optional fields: films[].flags, nearMisses[].imdb/rt. Not approved, not for app use until the owner signs off the roster, the method and the score-display licensing decision.
methodSummary: Eligibility (sole or credited TMDB Directing credit, feature or, where flagged, feature-length documentary) -> longlist with evidence panel -> tier by directing achievement (craft, innovation, influence, canon) with IMDb and RT used only as within-source ordinal sanity checks -> order within tier by documented editorial judgement. IMDb /10 and Tomatometer % are never averaged or combined.

imdb.source: IMDb non-commercial dataset title.ratings.tsv.gz (ratings and vote counts); title.basics and title.crew used to match ids and confirm sole directors
imdb.note: Dataset file run-date 2026-11-12, last-modified 2026-11-13 00:28 GMT. The live IMDb title page returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool on 2026-11-13, so ratings were not cross-checked against live pages. Dataset licence is personal / non-commercial use only; see SCORE_SOURCING_NOTES.md.

rt.source: Rotten Tomatoes film page, critics Tomatometer percentage and its critic review count
rt.note: Read through a text-extraction fetch tool, one film page at a time. Percentages were cross-checked against the RT celebrity filmography table where it listed them and, for some films, against search-result summaries of the same page. Review counts are live and change daily; each is a single dated read.

films.title: Spirited Away
films.originalTitle: 千と千尋の神隠し (Sen to Chihiro no kamikakushi)
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 2002 (US release); original release was 2001 (TMDB, IMDb).

films.rationale: Dreamlike bathhouse fantasy that became the highest-grossing film in Japanese history on its release and won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature; top on IMDb (8.6) and the strongest combined evidence.

films.title: My Neighbor Totoro
films.originalTitle: となりのトトロ (Tonari no Totoro)
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 1990 (limited US release); original release was 1988.

films.rationale: A film with almost no conflict, about two girls and nature spirits in a Japanese village; the most-loved Ghibli film and the clearest statement of his sensibility.

films.title: Princess Mononoke
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).
films.rationale: His epic of the conflict between industry and nature, with the deepest world-building and the biggest action; second-highest IMDb rating among his films (8.3) and a landmark of adult animation.

films.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
films.originalTitle: 魔女の宅急便 (Majo no takkyūbin)
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 1998 (US release); original release was 1989.

films.rationale: A gentle coming-of-age story about independence and burnout; the highest Tomatometer of his major films (98%).

films.title: Castle in the Sky
films.originalTitle: 天空の城ラピュタ (Tenkū no shiro Rapyuta)
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 1989 (US release); original release was 1986.

films.rationale: His first film for Studio Ghibli, a pure adventure of airships, pirates and a lost city; the model for much that followed (RT sample only 28 reviews).

films.title: The Wind Rises
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 2014 (US release); original release was 2013.

films.rationale: A biographical drama about the designer of the Zero fighter, treated as a meditation on creation and complicity; his most personal and most contested film, and an Oscar nominee for Best Animated Feature.

films.title: Howl's Moving Castle
films.originalTitle: ハウルの動く城 (Hauru no ugoku shiro)
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 2005 (US release); original release was 2004.

films.rationale: A romantic fantasy with flowing, hand-drawn invention and an anti-war undercurrent; higher on IMDb (8.2) than The Wind Rises but lower on the Tomatometer (87%).

films.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
films.originalTitle: 風の谷のナウシカ (Kaze no tani no Naushika)
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director. NOTE: TMDB id 81 is shown on its page as "Warriors of the Wind" with a 1h35m runtime (the shortened US cut), original title Kaze no tani no Naushika. IMDb tt0087544 is the 117-minute original. Confirm which version the app should use.

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 1985; original release was 1984. The RT sample is only 23 reviews.

films.rationale: The post-apocalyptic ecological epic that made the Ghibli name and set up the themes of Mononoke; made before Ghibli was founded.

films.title: The Boy and the Heron
films.originalTitle: 君たちはどう生きるか (Kimitachi wa dō ikiru ka)
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).
films.rationale: A late, enigmatic and dreamlike film with a different structure from his earlier work; won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature (2024) and has the largest critic sample in the ten (276 reviews); lowest IMDb rating among the ten (7.3).

films.title: Porco Rosso
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).
films.rationale: A wry romantic adventure about a pilot cursed to look like a pig; the closest call in the ten (see below).

nearMisses.title: Ponyo
nearMisses.reason: IMDb 7.6 and RT 91% from 173 reviews; a charming film with the broadest audience but a simpler story than the ten.

nearMisses.title: The Castle of Cagliostro
nearMisses.reason: His first feature (a Lupin III film); RT 95% from 21 reviews and IMDb 7.6. A reasonable alternate to Porco Rosso.

unverified: TMDB film ids and Directing credits were read from the TMDB person page on 2026-11-13 (no TMDB API key was available), not from the API crew.job field; title-to-id pairs were taken from the page links. Co-director status was checked against the IMDb dataset crew file (title.crew), which lists a sole director for every film in the list.
IMDb ids were matched in the IMDb dataset by original title, year and runtime, not read from a TMDB external_ids field; confirm with the TMDB API external_ids at implementation.
RT review counts are a single read on the stated date via a text fetcher.
IMDb title pages could not be read (HTTP 403); ratings and votes come from the official dataset (not cross-checked against the live pages), whose licence is non-commercial only.
TMDB id 81 (Nausicaä) page title/runtime reflect the US 'Warriors of the Wind' cut; the ledger keeps the id (it is the only Nausicaä id listed on his TMDB page) and flags the version question.
Year displayed on the TMDB person page was shifted for several films (for example Totoro shown as 1986); ids and titles were checked and the ledger uses original release years confirmed from IMDb.
